In addition, litter that has been sitting on the ground for too long (about 8 seconds) will get picked up by a little helper bot and brought to you in matches. This makes it easier to stay in the game and have fun, while not affecting high-level play very much.

Below is the detailed list of updates:

[/list]

Enjoy!

-mana

notes.title: Massive Update! - Story Mode, a New Character + Map, New Solo Play Modes + More!
notes.content:
Hello, generous friends.

It's been a good while since there's been an update, and that's because I've been working on getting everything ready for this huge update, available now!

There's so much in this update, we've got a [b]new character[/b], a [b]new map[/b], a bunch of single player modes like [b]Balloon Burst[/b], [b]Survival Mode[/b] and [b]Elimination Challenge[/b], plus a whole heckin' [b]Story Mode[/b]. In addition, there are [b]new Accessories[/b] to get, and [i][b]tons[/b][/i] of fixes, tweaks and improvements.

I'm really excited for you all to check out the new content, I really hope you enjoy it. And definitely check out the upcoming Friendship Games Festival that Shell Out is going to be in, which starts this Monday, the 13th of February. [u]Here are the details from the event host[/u]:

[b]﻿Friendship Games Week 2023 is back with a celebration of couch co-op, local multiplayer, and split-screen gaming! In the name of friendship, love, and family bonds you are yet again summoned to plug the game controllers in, find a good seat, and play video games together!

We collected and curated a merry bunch of indie titles for PC that can be played by 2 or more players on the same machine. Make sure to take your time while browsing the gallery for bestsellers, trendsetters, hidden gems, demos, upcoming games, and newfound niches!

Friendship Games Week is organized by Frogsong Studios.

When: February 13-19, 2023

Check it out during the event at: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FriendshipGamesWeek2023]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FriendshipGamesWeek2023[/url]
[/b]

And, here's the complete list of new stuff, updates and fixes for those who love the details:

[list]
[*] Story Mode (solo play)
[*] Balloon Burst Mode (solo play)
[*] Elimination Challenge Mode (solo play)
[*] Survival Mode (solo play)
[*] Multiplayer now has Elimination Mode and Point Rush mode as well as the ability to have teams for all play modes
[*] 20 more Steam achievements
[*] A bunch of new Accessories you can get in the shop and/or from beating Story Mode
[*] Improvements to game clarity and readability
[*] Many visual enhancements and improvements
[*] A big performance overhaul, should be much smoother and run at 60fps consistently
[*] Fixed problems and jank related to controllers doing weird stuff like controlling two players with one controller
[*] Improved network performance with threaded networking
[*] Improved flow of playing matches in solo/multiplayer lobbies
[*] Fixed some rendering issues on Ubuntu where the screen would be tiny in the corner
[*] Prevented getting COGs with unfair match settings
[*] Some camera improvements
[*] Anti-aliasing scaling shader (makes the game look clean and sharp at any size)
[*] Some minor map tweaks
[*] Picking up items player a little sound and flashes your character, to make it easier to know when you picked up an item
[*] Your items now magnetically move towards you when you are close to them (if you need to pick them up)
[*] Game mode is shown during match countdown
[/list]

This update brings a new mode to the game: Team Mode!
Turn it on in the lobby settings and team up with friends, frenemies, bots, online and offline!

Team Mode allows for new strategies and a different gameplay experience. Only one player on your team has to win for the whole team to win! So either go for emptying out your reserves, or block your teammates from getting items to take your team to victory!

In addition, this update includes some new screen filters, which can be changed in the game settings. Check them out!

notes.title: Shell Out Showdown Fully Released on Steam (in Japanese too!)
notes.content:
I'm very happy to announce that [b]Shell Out Showdown is fully released on Steam today![/b]

Early Access is done, thanks so much to everyone who helped me along the way and provided fun times and great feedback. I'm very proud of how this game has come together and am excited for it to be available in full.

To celebrate the release of this game, a [b]10% discount will be running on Steam for a whole week[/b], from April 4th through April 10th. 

Compared to the Early Access version, this release has more maps, custom room options, lobby emotes/chat, improved performance, offline local play,  Steam Cloud Saves, remastered music, and lots of tweaks, fixes and improvements to the play experience. In short: It's super fun!

In addition, the game has been translated to Japanese! With the help of Active Gaming Media, the translation has been completed and the press release for Japan is going out now! I'm excited to launch this game in Japan and for everyone to be able to play together online. It was a lot of fun learning a little bit about the truly amazing language the Japanese have and tackling the task of getting it into the game. If you speak and/or read Japanese, you can set the game language from the main menu in-game, or from the game's language settings in Steam.

So check out the full release on Steam now, and have fun tossing food at your friends in this give-to-win reverse battle-royale!

-Mana ːalphieː

notes.title: Offline Local Multiplayer Update! + lots of UX tweaks and bug fixes
notes.content:
I'm super excited to share this MEGA update with y'all!

[url=http://www.sacgamersexpo.com/]Sacramento Gamers Expo[/url] went really well and I got tons of great feedback and was inspired with lost of new ideas on how to improve the gameplay experience, and I'm releasing a big set of those changes today ːsteamhappyː

In addition to now being able to play locally with up to 4 players (no need to be connected to the internet anymore!), this update includes:

[list]
[*] Support for more controllers such as Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, PowerA Switch Controller, and Pokken Tournament Controller, plus many, many more
[*] A reorganized menu for choosing the game type
[*] Fixed deadzone problems and accidental double tap dashes on controllers
[*] Changed the mall level to remove janky stairs and make it easier to get around
[*] When someone is about to win, all items on the ground can be picked up by anybody! This eliminates the "oh no, I don't have any items" problem
[*] Indicators of what items are yours and who owns what items in local multiplayer are more clear and readable (and more obvious and easy to find)
[*] +/-1 indicators when receiving/giving items
[*] Now at least one item per player with remain in play to limit players from having no items
[*] Improved local multiplayer stats section to be easier to read and understand
[*] Player who is winning now very clearly indicated with new visuals, effects and sound
[*] Fixed bug where jumping after bouncing off a spring would slow you down
[*] Fixed bots moving erratically, now they smooth and silky :)
[*] Fixed camera not zooming quick enough and players going off screen in local multiplayer
[/list]

I have a lot more updates coming, including new levels and characters. So stay tuned for that! Hope y'all have fun!

-Mana

notes.title: Local Multiplayer is here! +lots of tweaks, updates and fixes
notes.content:
Hello, generous humans! I've got a big update for you, available now, which [b]adds support for playing with up to 4 players on the same computer![/b] You and 3 friends can all play together online, either in a private lobby or the public one. That's right, [b]everyone can play online from just one computer![/b] In addition, the game will now support [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b], so you can share the fun with anyone you like, near or far!

Y'all asked for it, and I'm happy to be able to make this happen for y'all. This is a huge update and I think it will add a lot of value to your purchase of the game. You can play with others either using up to 4 controllers, or you can use the keyboard for player 1 and up to 3 controllers for the other players.

In addition to that, I've also made a lot of improvements to the server, improved performance of the game, fixed some bugs, made some small tweaks to the camera movement, and updated the music with some new lines and more even volume. You can see the detailed list of changes at the bottom.

As usual, I am happy to hear any feedback you have on how the game is progressing and anything you'd like to see. [url=https://linktr.ee/manadream]Message me on socials[/url] or reply to this or any post, or in the forums. If you are going to be in the Sacramento, CA area during Dec 18-19, I'll be at the [url=http://www.sacgamersexpo.com/]Sac Gamers Expo[/url] demoing Shell Out Showdown in person. Stop by and say hi, I'd love to chat with you and play a few rounds!

Thanks so much for all the support and I sincerely hope you enjoy this update. ^_^

Here are the detailed updates for this release:
[list]
[*]Local Multiplayer with up to 4 players
[*]Fixed dropped packets to server and improved server efficiency and throughput
[*]Tweaked and fixed incorrect rendering of some Effects from the Shop
[*]Fixed bug that prevented players from saving more than 9999 Charity Points to their save file
[*]Fixed overlays sometimes persisting between sections of the game
[*]Smoothed out camera movement so it feels less jarring
[*]Fixed soft lock if game loses network connection at the beginning of a match
[*]Reduced sensitivity of dashing by double pressing a direction to reduce accidental dashes
[*]Improved rendering performance to work better on lower powered machines (tested on an 8-year old laptop at 60 FPS)
[*]Now always returns players to lobby after a match instead of going to the main menu
[*]Small tweaks to most of the in-game songs, a new part in one of the songs, and better balanced music volume
[/list]

In addition, shop items now only cost either [b]Certificates of Generosity[/b] (CoGs, Gold) or [b]Charity Points[/b] (Green), and the experience system has been simplified to show you what level you are and what level items in the shop require to purchase.

Players will now also get [b]rewards on leveling up[/b]! Get accessories you don't have or bonus CoGs when you level up after a match.

This update also includes some minor bug fixes, visual tweaks and other improvements to make your experience in the game better.

I hope that you enjoy the update and keep your eyes peeled for more updates coming soon. Thanks to everyone that has encouraged the continued development of the game and to everyone playing the game and sharing a fun time with friends. I greatly appreciate all the kindness and support I've received, and I hope that my work continues to facilitate moments of joy and laughter for you all.

-Mana

notes.title: Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
I'm super excited to announce that Shell Out Showdown is now officially available in Early Access on Steam!

I've been working super hard to get the game to a release-ready state and I'm proud to be able to release the game today. Compared to the demo, the release has a bunch of new content. It has 4 levels, some new level mechanics, 39+ character customizations, and several new music tracks. I sincerely hope that you enjoy the new content, and I will be continuing to add content to the game during the Early Access period.

The game will be in Early Access for at least a few months, perhaps more, and I'll be adding content during that time. The game's price is discounted during the Early Access period, after which it will go up. I greatly appreciate your support during Early Access, it means a lot to me that you would buy the game in its earlier stages and it really does make a huge difference in my life.

Thanks to everyone who helped me get to this point, I greatly appreciate all the love and support I've received. I hope you enjoy the game and feel that your purchase is worth it! I try hard to make quality games full of fun gameplay and good content.

Thanks again for the support,
-Mana

notes.title: New Performance Option for Lower Powered Computers
notes.content:
Hey y'all!

In an effort to support players with older or lower powered computers, I have added a framerate adjustment option to the "Options" section of the game. You can choose between a few different render framerates to maximize the performance of the game on your machine!

I hope that this helps and makes the game playable for people on lower powered machines. Please do let me know if there are any additional performance issues or problems that you experience, as I want to make my games as accessible as I can.

Also, a big thanks to everyone who stopped by the Next Fest streams. I really appreciate all the support and am looking forward to the early access release, which will have new shop items, new maps, and more.

I hope you enjoy the demo until then!

-Mana

notes.title: Next Fest Special: Shell Out Showdown Play Session
notes.content:

notes.title: Playable Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce that the playable demo for Shell Out Showdown is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556660/Shell_Out_Showdown/]available now on Steam[/url]!

I've been working on this game over the last 9 months as a part of the Bay Area Dev (B.A.D.) I will continue to develop and improve this game, as well as add more content such as levels, characters and customizations, and I want to involve you in that process (if you feel so inclined). After Next Fest, I will release the game in early access, and the demo will be taken down.

I would be very grateful for you all to be a part of this game in its early stages and I hope you enjoy what the game has to offer!
